title: The Filtration Plant of the East Jersey Water Company at Little Falls, N.J.
authors: Society of Municipal Engineers of the City of New York
lineage: Paraphrased historical research notes on inspected passages, not a reproduction of the source. The 1904 year identifies the proceedings and inspection; the precise publication date was not separately established.

passages.locator: Printed p. 192, inspection heading and plant description
passages.note: The contemporary society proceedings record an inspection on 11 June 1904 and describe the East Jersey plant, including 32 filters each with a stated nominal daily capacity of one million gallons. Rated capacity does not establish actual output or number of customers.
